$comment: Contract between vision-pipeline (producer) and backend-assistant (consumer). Do not change field names without telling the other person.
bay: string, e.g. 'bay-1' (hardcode per demo video if only one bay)
package_id: string, tracker id assigned to this carton for its whole lifetime in frame

policy.max_drop_height_m: float, 0 means must never be dropped
policy.source: string, 'label_extracted' | 'default_unknown' (true when no pictogram was detected/read)

detected_behavior: string, one of: dropped | dragged | over_stacked | wrong_orientation | thrown | rough_handling | stepped_on | none

evidence.clip_path: string, path to the short evidence clip for this event

risk_level: string, one of: low | medium | high | critical
requires_human_review: bool, true whenever risk_level is high or critical
